subject: [Aria] Company offsite in Tuscany — May
body:
Hi,

I got your name from a friend who attended a wedding you did on Lake Como last year — she hasn't stopped talking about the band.

We're planning our annual company offsite for next May: about 120 people, three days, somewhere in Tuscany. We want it to feel special — boutique venues, great food, and live music is the piece we care most about. Budget is approved on our side, roughly $250k for the event overall.

Could you tell me how you usually work and whether May is still open?

Best,
Maya Chen
Head of People Operations, Figma
maya.chen@figma.com
+1 415 555 0182

subject: [Aria] Exploring options for a leadership summit
body:
Hello,

I'm reaching out on behalf of our Chief Revenue Officer. We're exploring a week-long leadership summit for around 400 people — thinking Tuscany, possibly Kyoto, dates still open. Entertainment and atmosphere are a big part of the brief.

We'd prefer to discuss budget on a call once we understand what you offer.

Warm regards,
Priya Nair
EA to the CRO, Stripe
priya.nair@stripe.com
